text.description_html:
Kwikset 966PML, Single Cylinder Wellington Handleset Interior Trim Replacement with Pembroke Lever

This is a Single Cylinder Wellington Handleset Interior Trim Replacement with Pembroke Lever. The Pembroke Lever Single Cylinder Interior Trim for Wellington Handleset delivers elegant style by evoking a sense of the past. With traditional style, the Kwikset 966PML Pembroke Lever with Thumbturns is a great addition to classic homes.

Features and Specifications of the Kwikset Pembroke Lever Interior Trip for the 800WN Oval Wellington Door Entry Set:

  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Lever Length: 3-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-7/18"
  • Deadbolt to Latch Spacing: 5-1/2" center to center
  • Non-handed levers (except half dummy function).
  • Concealed screws.

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
